integrity: Exact all-n mathematical proof and independently implemented finite-field sample checker; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Covers only the top adjoint Jordan block and its degeneration locus for strictly upper-triangular type-A Lie algebras, not all blocks or other nilradicals. Known n=5 special case is credited; unindexed equivalent remains possible.
title: Lucas congruences govern maximal adjoint Jordan chains in niltriangular Lie algebras
